reference.model: binary64 scalar reference from canonical bytes; authored f32 UV/color inputs; target quantization after every write
reference.interpolation: fixed planar orthographic/affine barycentric weights, not observed browser pixels; no claim of GPU interpolation bit identity

settings.qualification: Source/device/frame/recipe/serial and closure identity must pass before any color result is called PASS.
settings.geometry: Color points use pixel centers >=2px from triangle and clip edges. Explicit coverage-only seam/clip probes use exact integer edges and non-corner centers.
settings.cssEvidence: Black/white background screenshots are separately preserved; raw color bounds do not certify ICC or physical display.

negatives.model: Average encoded black/white first and decode once instead of filtering decoded texels
Treat straight encoded RGB codes as linear source before target transfer
Omit material dark term while preserving every other source/alpha factor
Multiply already premultiplied sampled RGB by its alpha again; alpha unchanged
Expand opaque red content by clamping without virtual trim coverage
Use unclamped packed left edge q=0 with page linear filtering; red content sees blue neighbor
Substitute CSS-like source-over multiply for both factor layers on transparent black; white stays white
Copy stored internal sRGB-PMA target codes directly to premultiplied canvas
Interpolate encoded vertex RGB first, then decode rather than per-vertex D-before-f32 upload
Swap final raw R/B channels after actual storage-format normalization
Sort A-B-A to A-A-B while keeping the same three genuine layers

limitations: Input-to-reference relationships were independently reconstructed from pages and authored draws using the shared scalar oracle. This does not establish native quality or a second independent color oracle.
Negative model margins establish scalar discriminability only. Actual single-location copied-product mutants need separately frozen source/pins and healthy/mutant/restored execution.
Runtime/source identity, canonical cap exactness, authority, fees, cleanup and READY counts remain CPU/public-port controls, not tolerance-based pixel claims.
Unknown native device eligibility is INCOMPLETE, never quality PASS. An observed valid named-point bound violation is FAIL; do not widen thresholds or drop points.
Only <=4 effective writes are qualified here; full Spine runtime/adapter, arbitrary layer counts, source formats or M1.2 performance are not established.
